ns2:course.label: Selection of Materials
ns2:course.description: (MATSE 446) Broad comparative study of the mechanical, thermal and chemical properties of all classes of materials (metals, polymers, ceramics, and composites); material selection maps, performance indexing and computer-aided material selection tools; mechanical and chemical failure of materials and preventive methods; material selection project. Credit is not given to MS and PhD thesis students who received their BS degree in MatSE. Credit is not given for both MSE 586 and MSE 486. Prerequisite: TAM 251 and AE 321 or equivalents.
